notes: Recorded as a door because the headline number is large enough that the next session will find it and chase it. The per-applicant amount is not published anywhere checked, which is the real finding: a NGN 500,000,000 programme with no stated per-account cap is not a quota, it is a fund. The NGN 70,000 Deploy credit is the only individually reachable piece and it is awarded by editorial selection.
